notes.title: Small Tweaks & Fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fix: Music was not played in some levels, such as Level 4.
[*] Tweak: Added the option to jump with the 'C' key, in addition to the up arrow key. This should make it easier for players who prefer using the arrow keys to jump.
[*] Fix: Removed some debugging hotkeys that were accidentally left in the game. So sorry to all cheaters who used them [b]harrr harr *evil laughing*[/b])
[/list]
